answer_2.quote: The model training performance was evaluated using mean squared error (MSE)...; We evaluated model performance ... computing pairwise rank correlations (Kendall, type "c") between model‑assigned emotional valence scores and mean scores from the bank of human annotators.

answer_4.quote: The hand‑curated list of 434 messages was then presented to anonymous raters on the Amazon Mechanical Turk (mTurk) platform... Participants were asked to rate the emotional valence of each statement on a scale from 0 (most negative) to 100 (most positive).
answer_4.guideline: Raters were instructed to assign a numerical emotional valence score reflecting the negativity or positivity of each statement.
